reason: An SSH-based remote development plugin that mounts server workspaces into the web GUI and provides remote files, terminals, conversations, agents, provisioning, and skills access.

summaries.zh: 通过SSH连接远程服务器，将远程项目挂载到DeepSeek Harness网页界面并提供远程文件、终端、会话和智能体开发能力。
summaries.en: Connects to SSH servers to mount remote projects in the DeepSeek Harness web interface and provide remote files, terminals, sessions, and agent-based development.

capabilities: Provisions a remote DeepSeek Harness installation and runtime
Reads and writes mounted project files over SSH/SFTP
Runs remote terminals, code sessions, and agents
Stores server connection settings and credentials
Copies runtime packages from the local machine to a remote server when needed
